name: Knowledge Retention Backend V5.0
description: Backend state machine for guided knowledge-retention interviews over Dataverse and SharePoint

authFields.label: Client ID
authFields.description: Application (client) ID of the Azure app registration used for app-only access to Dataverse and Microsoft Graph.

authFields.label: Client secret
authFields.description: Client secret of the Azure app registration. Rotate before the configured expiry; expiry surfaces to interviewees as a contact-your-administrator error.

authFields.label: Dataverse environment URL
authFields.description: Base URL of the Dataverse environment, with no trailing slash (e.g. https://org12345.crm4.dynamics.com).

authFields.label: Knowledge prefill enabled
authFields.description: Set to true to offer a discovery-only profile draft from the interviewee's recent Microsoft 365 work. While false or blank, consent is skipped and discovery runs question by question. This does not pre-fill interview answers. Set it before an interview starts.

authFields.label: SharePoint site ID
authFields.description: Microsoft Graph site ID of the central CKR team site that stores interview folders. Format: host,siteCollectionId,webId.

authFields.label: Tag test folders
authFields.description: Set to true on DEV and test connections to name interview folders Interviews/[DEV] 42. Leave false or blank in production for Interviews/42. Set it before testing starts; changing it mid-interview splits that interview's files across two folders.

authFields.label: Tenant ID
authFields.description: Microsoft Entra tenant ID (GUID) of the BASF tenant that hosts the Dataverse environment and the CKR SharePoint site.

authFields.label: Minimum topics
authFields.description: Fewest topics generated per interview (1–10). Leave blank for 4.

authFields.label: Maximum topics
authFields.description: Most topics generated per interview (1–10). Leave blank for 6.

authFields.label: Minimum questions per topic
authFields.description: Fewest questions generated per topic (1–15). Leave blank for 3.

authFields.label: Maximum questions per topic
authFields.description: Most questions generated per topic (1–15). Leave blank for 6.
